app.disclaimer: Unofficial open-source project. Not affiliated with Hanlinyue. Settings are stored only in this browser.

afterSave.body: Unplug the USB-C cable when you're done. The page turner then enters pairing mode (the indicator light breathes), so you can pair it over Bluetooth with your reader, phone or computer.

connect.eyebrow: Hanlinyue Free2 · Free3 · E1 Pro · E3 Control
connect.title: Connect your page turner
connect.subtitle: Remap buttons, record macros and set the lights right in your browser. Nothing to install.
connect.step1: Plug the page turner into this computer with a USB-C cable.
connect.step2: Click “Connect via USB” and choose the device in the browser's list. It may be listed as “USB Composite Device”.
connect.step3: Change settings and save. Unplug the cable afterwards to use it over Bluetooth.
connect.unsupportedTitle: This browser can't talk to USB devices
connect.unsupportedBody: Open this page in Chrome, Edge or Opera on a desktop computer. Safari, Firefox and mobile browsers don't support Web Serial.
connect.noSerial: USB needs Chrome, Edge or Opera on a desktop computer.
connect.busy: The device is busy. Close the official Hanlinyue app and any other tab using it, then try again.
connect.closeOfficial: Close the official Hanlinyue app and other browser tabs that might be using the device.
connect.linuxHint: On Linux, make sure your user can open serial ports (for example, add it to the dialout group), then reconnect.
connect.bleNote: Bluetooth configuration is experimental and may not work with every model or firmware version. USB is recommended.
connect.demo: No device at hand? Try the demo →

unsupported.title: This model isn't supported yet
unsupported.body: The connected device reports itself as “{model}”, which this configurator doesn't know yet. Please open an issue with that model name so support can be added.

presets.subtitle: Pick a ready-made layout for the buttons, then save it to the device.

shift.label: Slide switch
shift.hint: Settings are saved to the selected switch position.

custom.subtitle: Click a button on the device to choose which keys or phone action it sends.
custom.nothingToSave: Choose an action for at least one button first.
custom.profilesHint: Keep up to three layouts in this browser. Pick a profile to load it; saving while a profile is selected also stores the layout in it.

scripts.recordHint: Press Record, then type the keys you want the button to play back.

light.subtitle: Choose a button, then pick how its light behaves.

modeHint.rainbow: Fades smoothly through the color spectrum.
modeHint.custom: A fixed color and brightness of your choice.

more.firmwareNote: Firmware updates use Hanlinyue's own Windows tool, which can't run in a browser. Use a Windows PC with the official client to update, or contact support.
more.logHint: Raw commands exchanged with the device. Useful when reporting a problem.
more.about: This open-source configurator talks to your page turner directly from the browser using the same protocol as the official Hanlinyue app. Your settings are remembered only in this browser.
